IN-STAT-0001.text: Bees and poultry are counted as animals under the Act. The species listed alongside cattle are dog, cat, pig, horse, camel, ass, mule, poultry, bees, and any other animal or bird as specified by the Central Government.

IN-STAT-0003.text: The term 'State' in the Representation of the People Act, 1950 does not cover a Union territory, as the provision specifically refers to 'a State of Jammu and Kashmir or in a Union territory not having a Legislative Assembly' separately.

IN-STAT-0004.text: A Hindu child is treated as a minor up to the age of eighteen years, as stated in 'a person who has not completed the age of eighteen years' (s. 4(a), provision 1).

IN-STAT-0007.text: For the upper house created by statute for Tamil Nadu in 2010, the meaning of words the statute itself leaves undefined is found in "the Representation of the People Act, 1950 (43 of 1950)" as per section 2 of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Council Act, 2010.

IN-STAT-0008.text: In Manipur's levy on fuel and engine lubricants, 'crude oil' covers unrefined petroleum, and 'greases' are taxed as lubricants. This is defined in section 2(e) of the Manipur (Sales of Motor Spirit and Lubricants) Taxation Act, 1962, which states that 'lubricant' includes all forms of greases.

IN-STAT-0013.text: The inner wrapping that touches food must be 'food grade' and 'free from contaminants' as per 'Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulation, 2018 — Pt. III, s. 4(1)(c)'. The outer layer must 'carry the necessary information or the label on the container shall be readily legible through the outer wrapper and not obscured by it' as per 'Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulation, 2011 — s. 6'.

IN-STAT-0014.text: A staged show streamed live on television does not fall within what the broadcast-advertising limits treat as programming, as per 'the time gap between end of one advertisement session and the commencement of next advertisement session shall not be less than fifteen minutes' (s. 3(4), proviso to s. 3(4)), which specifically excludes live broadcast of a sporting event, and by extension, staged shows streamed live.

IN-STAT-0015.text: A 'family of models' is defined as 'group of models for which all the performance parameters are same' under [1] Pt. III, s. 2 (b).

IN-STAT-0016.text: No, daily-wage workers are not counted as employees under the Bureau of Indian Standards' rules on its Director General's powers. 'employee' means officers and employees in the whole time service of the Bureau but does not include a person employed on daily wages (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0018.text: The 'Appellate Authority' means the Secretary to the Government of India in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

IN-STAT-0019.text: An 'investor' for the fund that protects investors under company law refers to 'eligible and identifiable applicants for shares or debentures' as per section 125(3)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013.

IN-STAT-0020.text: Yes, 'Chairman' includes someone holding the post temporarily. 'Chairman' includes the temporary Chairman and President of the Municipal Council.

IN-STAT-0021.text: The Sanctioning Authority sanctions a Goa legislator's advance for buying a new car.

IN-STAT-0022.text: The officer must be 'not below the rank of Group II Inspector by whatever designation called' as stated in section 2(d) of the Uttar Pradesh Sahkari Gram Vikas Bank Rules 1971.

IN-STAT-0023.text: In Karnataka's civil service rules, being appointed 'on probation' means 'appointed on trial' as defined in the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977, s. 2 (1) and also in the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, s. 2 (1) (a).

IN-STAT-0026.text: The Board is 'the Uttar Pradesh Rural Housing Board established under section 3' as per provision [1] UTTAR PRADESH RURAL HOUSING BOARD ACT, 1983 — Ch. I, s. 2 (a).

IN-STAT-0028.text: No, cars that a diplomat imports tax-free are not covered by the customs concession for foreign envoys. "Nothing contained in article 36 of the Convention set out in the Schedule shall be construed to entitle a diplomatic mission or member thereof to import into India goods free of any duty of customs without any restrictions on their subsequent sale therein."

IN-STAT-0029.text: The Chairman of the District Committee shall preside over the meeting.

IN-STAT-0030.text: The managing 'committee' of a co-operative society in Kerala refers to 'the governing body of a society, by whatever name called, to which by the constitution, bye-laws or rules of the society the management of its affairs is entrusted' (Provision [1](a)).

IN-STAT-0031.text: Yes, the heir of a trader who has died can use Goa's 2023 one-time scheme to clear old tax dues, as the term 'applicant' includes 'his legal heir' under section 2(b) of the Goa (Recovery of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty, Other Dues through Settlement) Act, 2023.

IN-STAT-0032.text: Yes, using a wireless gadget counts as 'unfair means' as per 'the use of any unauthorized telephonic, wireless or electronic or other instrument or gadget' under section 2(c) of the Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1992. The examination centre extends to 'the entire premises attached thereto' as per section 2(a) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0034.text: The statues of the deity and offerings given on temple grounds belong to the 'Shrine Fund' as defined in section 3(h) of the Jammu and Kashmir Shri Mata Sukhrala Devi Ji Shrine and Shri Mata Bala Sundari Shrine Act, 2013. This includes offerings made to any of the deities comprised in the Shrines.

IN-STAT-0035.text: Under Kerala's law, an open space is defined as any land on which there are no buildings or of which not more than one-twentieth part is covered with buildings.

IN-STAT-0036.text: No, the tenant cannot claim compensation for a makeshift well as an improvement under the Kerala Compensation for Tenants Improvements Act, 1958. 'Temporary wells and water-channels as are made by the tenant in the ordinary course of cultivation and without any special expenditure or any other benefit accruing to land from the ordinary operations of husbandry' are excluded from the definition of 'improvement' under section 2(b).

IN-STAT-0037.text: A 'goonda' is a person who either by himself or as a member or leader of a gang habitually commits or attempts to commit or abets the commission of an offence under section 294 or under Chapter XVI, Chapter XVII or Chapter XXII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, or is so desperate and dangerous as to render his being at large in a particular area hazardous or nuisance to the community.

IN-STAT-0039.text: The Madhya Pradesh Extension of Laws Act, 1958 (No. 23 of 1958), shall have the meanings respectively assigned to them in that Act.

IN-STAT-0040.text: The university was constituted under the "Gandhiji University Act, 1985 (12 of 1985)" as defined in provision [1] s. 2 (a).

IN-STAT-0042.text: A 'Bulk user of water' is defined as any person whose consumption of water exceeds '3000 cubic meters per day' as per section 2(1A) of the Goa Irrigation Act, 1973.

IN-STAT-0043.text: In the Rajasthan Official Language Act, 1956, 'the State' means 'the new State of Rajasthan as formed by section 10 of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 (Central Act 37 of 1956)' as per section 2(1).

IN-STAT-0044.text: Raising cattle for milk is not an agricultural use under the Himachal Pradesh Town and Country Planning Act, 1977 as it is explicitly excluded in section 2(a)(i). Running a plant nursery is an agricultural use under the Kota Development Authority Act, 2023 as it is included in the definition of 'agriculture' in section 2(1).

IN-STAT-0045.text: Yes, a courtesy pass counts as a 'ticket' under the Himachal Pradesh Prevention of Ticketless Travel in Road Transport Service Act, 1976. 'ticket' includes a duty, privilege or courtesy pass issued under the authority of the State Transport Undertaking.

IN-STAT-0048.text: An appeal against any refusal, admission or determination under sections seven, eight or nine shall lie, if preferred within six weeks from the date of such determination, to the Commissioner of Division to whom the Manager is subordinate, and the decision of such Commissioner, or of the Manager if no such appeal has been so preferred, shall be final.

IN-STAT-0050.text: The maximum imprisonment for coaxing a married woman to leave her husband for an illicit relationship is 'for a term which may extend to two years' under sections 498 of the Indian Penal Code and section 84 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

IN-STAT-0052.text: The person so compelled shall report the matter to the law enforcement authority or investigating agency within a period of seven days from the date of giving such undue advantage. The maximum sentence for offering a bribe is imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years or with fine or with both.

IN-STAT-0053.text: The period of such deputation shall in no case extend beyond a period of three years from the appointed day.

IN-STAT-0054.text: The lease of such land is for a period of thirty years or more.

IN-STAT-0055.text: The maximum period for which a person can be ordered to stay out of the capital by an externment direction is "not exceeding six months" as specified in section 3(3)(a) of the Jharkhand Control of Crimes Act, 2002.

IN-STAT-0056.text: If any person enters the signal-room of a telegraph office without permission of competent authority, he shall be punished with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees.

IN-STAT-0057.text: The minimum prison term for wilfully trying to dodge the tax on high spending in hotels is 'rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than six months' under the Hotel-Receipts Tax Act, 1980 s. 26 (1) (i) and the Assam Tax on Luxuries (Hotels and Lodging Houses) Act, 1989 s. 18 (1) (b).

IN-STAT-0059.text: The Central Government had to adapt existing laws by order within "two years from the appointed day" as provided in 'High Court at Bombay (Extension of Jurisdiction to Goa, Daman and Diu) Act, 1981 — s. 14' and 'Goa, Daman and Diu (Administration) Act, 1962 — s. 5'.

IN-STAT-0062.text: A private citizen must give notice of not less than sixty days, in the manner prescribed, of the alleged offence and of his intention to make a complaint, to the Central Government or the authority or officer authorised as aforesaid.

IN-STAT-0064.text: For a period of one year from that day

IN-STAT-0065.text: Every owner of land planted with cardamom plants shall, before the expiration of one month from the date on which he first became owner of such estate or estates, apply to the registering officer...

IN-STAT-0066.text: If, after issue of a notice under section 6, the prescribed authority fails to certify within the prescribed time, the Court may, if it thinks fit, continue the proceeding.

IN-STAT-0067.text: The appeal must be filed within "thirty days from the date on which the order made by the Magistrate is served on the aggrieved person or the respondent, as the case may be, whichever is later."

IN-STAT-0068.text: The punishment for performing phooka on a cow to increase its milk is a fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with both, and the animal on which the operation was performed shall be forfeited to the Government.

IN-STAT-0070.text: The first Vice-Chancellor and first Registrar served for a term of three years, as per "each of the said officers shall hold office for a term of three years" (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0071.text: A member who has held two consecutive terms of office shall be eligible for re-nomination only after the expiry of a period of two years from the date he ceases to be member of the Pension Advisory Committee.

IN-STAT-0072.text: The shareholders’ director appointed by the Board shall hold office for a term of four years and shall be eligible for re-election or re-appointment for another four years.

IN-STAT-0073.text: No subject disposed of by the Institute at a meeting shall be brought up again for consideration until and after the expiry of one year except in a case where the President or Government certifies that the subject required further consideration in the interest of the Institute.

IN-STAT-0074.text: For ship-hull cover, '100 percent of Net Written Premium during the preceding twelve months' must be set aside for policies still running.

IN-STAT-0075.text: A consumer in Himachal Pradesh has 30 days from the order to appeal an electricity-theft assessment, and an amount equal to 1[half] of the assessed amount must be deposited first.

IN-STAT-0076.text: The insurance broker shall within 21 days from the date of receipt of communication respond to the Authority.

IN-STAT-0077.text: The records relating to the requests referred to in sub-regulation (1) shall be retained by the distributor of television channels for a minimum period of three months from the date of receipt of such request from the subscriber.

IN-STAT-0078.text: The over-drawal/under-drawal of electricity by any buyer during the time block shall not exceed 12% of its scheduled drawal, when grid frequency is '49.85Hz' and above but below 50.05 Hz

IN-STAT-0080.text: Every grid operator shall undergo training in real time digital simulator and a refresher course at least once in two years.

IN-STAT-0081.text: Every broadcaster shall, within sixty days of receipt of written request from a distributor of television channels for obtaining signals of television channel or within thirty days of signing of interconnection agreement with the distributor, as the case may be, provide, on non-discriminatory basis, the signals of television channel to the distributor.

IN-STAT-0082.text: The longest ban a customs chief can impose on a clearing agent for neglecting duties at a port is 'prohibit any Custom House Agent from working in one or more sections of the Customs Station' under Regulation 22 of the Customs House Agents Licensing Regulations, 1984.

IN-STAT-0083.text: The staff of a partner institution must have a minimum of three years’ research or teaching experience or both to become adjunct faculty of the Faridabad biotechnology centre. This is specified in 'only the regular research and academic staff of the Recognised Centre having Doctor of Philosophy or Doctor of Medicine degree with a minimum of three years’ research or teaching experience or both shall be eligible for recognition as an adjunct faculty of the Regional Centre' (citation: 1).

IN-STAT-0085.text: Existing private warehouses had to meet the new requirements within a period of three months from the date of commencement of these regulations.

IN-STAT-0086.text: For a minimum period of two years or such other period as may be determined by the Central Government, logs and documentation of the telecommunication network architecture of Critical Telecommunication Infrastructure must be preserved.

IN-STAT-0087.text: The heir must have attained the age of eighteen years within three years from the date of death of the person deceased and must make an application within two years thereafter.

IN-STAT-0090.text: A member expelled from a cooperative must wait for a period of two years from the date of such expulsion before being eligible for re-admission as a member of that society or any other registered society, as provided in "No members of registered society, who has been expelled under the provisions of its bye-laws, shall be eligible for readmission as a member of that society, or for admission as a member of any other registered society, for a period of two years from the date of such expulsion" (citations: [2]).

IN-STAT-0091.text: The notice for meeting shall be issued in such manner so as to reach the chairperson and members at least three days in advance.

IN-STAT-0092.text: The costs of the application are in the discretion of the Court or Judge, who may order the bank to pay if incurred due to its fault or improper delay. A bank employee cannot be forced to bring the books unless ordered by the Court or Judge for special cause.

IN-STAT-0093.text: The Indian Statistical Institute must provide 'such returns or other information with respect to its policies or activities as the Central Government may, for the purpose of reporting to the Parliament or for the making of policy, from time to time, require' (Provision [2]). The government panel may examine 'the work done by the Institute and the progress made by it', 'its buildings, equipment and other assets', and 'advise Government generally on any matter which in the opinion of the Central Government is of importance in connection with the work of the Institute' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0094.text: The Centre may cancel a licence for a new factory if the licensee fails to establish the undertaking within the specified time or extended time, as per 'the Central Government is satisfied... to establish the new industrial undertaking...' (s. 12(1)). A Government other than the Central Government may set up such an undertaking without a licence, with the previous permission of the Central Government, as per 'a Government other than the Central Government may... establish a new industrial undertaking' (s. 11(1)).

IN-STAT-0098.text: The amount of compensation is determined in accordance with section 21, but in calculating the compensation payable, no account shall be taken of the value of any uranium contained in the substance.

IN-STAT-0099.text: Bihar ceded the territories specified in sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Bihar and West Bengal (Transfer of Territories) Act, 1956 to West Bengal. The constitutional description was altered by inserting that Bihar's territory shall not include these specified territories, while West Bengal's territory shall include them.

IN-STAT-0101.text: The Commission must submit an annual report to the Central Government, as per 'The Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (Form and Manner of Furnishing Annual Report) Regulations, 2022' (provision [4]), and the Central Government shall cause every such report to be laid before both Houses of Parliament, as per 'Delhi Urban Art Commission Act, 1973' (provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0102.text: The Board appoints an officer of the Board as an Investigating Officer or may request a State or Central Government agency to investigate. Complaints of individual consumers are left to consumer forums under the Consumer Protection Act, 1986.

IN-STAT-0103.text: The governing board of the Chennai dance and arts foundation must meet at least twice in a year at Madras, as per 'The Governing Board shall meet at least twice in a year at Madras' (provision [1]). The rules on quorum are specified by regulations, as stated in 'The Governing Board shall observe such procedure in regard to the transaction of its business at its meetings (including the quorum at its meetings) as may be specified by regulations' (provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0104.text: The confirming authority may mitigate, remit, or commute the sentence to a lower punishment in the scale laid down in section 47, or set aside illegal proceedings. The shortest custody punishment on the scale is not explicitly defined, but the confirming authority may direct imprisonment in civil prison or Security Guard custody.

IN-STAT-0105.text: A person accused of the crime of apartheid can be tried in any place in which he may be found or as directed by the Central Government under section 5 of the Anti-Apartheid (United Nations Convention) Act, 1981. The heaviest punishment is death, as provided in section 3 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0106.text: The integrated GST law is treated as extended to Jammu and Kashmir from the 8th day of July, 2017, as per "It shall be deemed to have come into force on the 8th day of July, 2017." The exclusion of "except the State of Jammu and Kashmir*" was removed from section 1, sub-section (2) of the principal Act, as per "With effect from the date of commencement of this Act, in the principal Act, in section 1, in sub-section (2), the words "except the State of Jammu and Kashmir*" shall be omitted."

IN-STAT-0107.text: The authority managing a national highway may shut it to traffic for a while on the grounds that the highway is or has become congested or unsafe for vehicular or pedestrian traffic by reason of damage or otherwise, as per 'If at any time the Highway Administration is satisfied...unsafe for vehicular or pedestrian traffic by reason of damage or otherwise, it may...' (citations: [2], [5]).

IN-STAT-0108.text: Yes, the ban on unauthorised use of the Red Cross emblem applies on an Indian ship at sea. The use of the emblem on Indian ships or aircraft requires the approval of the Central Government, as stated in 'No person shall, without the approval of the Central Government, use...'

IN-STAT-0111.text: The Central Advisory Board shall meet at least once in every six months and shall observe such rules of procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be prescribed.

IN-STAT-0112.text: A company that bought a trade receivable can demand payment from the buyer only if notice of the assignment is given to the debtor by the assignor or the assignee along with express authority in its favor granted by the assignor, as per "Any assignee of a receivable shall not be entitled to demand payment of the receivable from the debtor in respect of such receivables unless notice of such assignment is given to the debtor by the assignor or the assignee along with express authority in its favors granted by the assignor." (citation: [1]). Paying the original seller stops discharging the debt if the debtor has not received notice of the assignment, as per "The payment is valid, and C cannot sue A for the debt." (citation: [5]).

IN-STAT-0114.text: When a multi-state cooperative converts into a farmers' producer company, it requires a majority in number representing three-fourths in value of the creditors or Members present and voting, as per "a majority in number representing three-fourths in value of the creditors, or Members, as the case may be, present and voting in person at the meeting conducted in pursuance of the directions of the Tribunal under sub-section (2), agree for re-conversion" (Provision 1). The property of the cooperative shall remain with the converted company, as no specific disposition is mentioned in the provisions.

IN-STAT-0115.text: The Centre must publish an annual report of activities financed under the national fund against drug abuse, as per section 7B of the NARCOTIC DRUGS AND PSYCHOTROPIC SUBSTANCES ACT,1985. The money that goes into that fund includes an amount provided by Parliament, sale proceeds of forfeited property, grants, and income from investments, as specified in section 7A of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0116.text: A Prize Court has the same powers as a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in respect of the matters listed in sub-section (1) of section 7. Parties have ninety days from the date of the order or decree to appeal to the Central Government, as per section 6.

IN-STAT-0119.text: The person who falsely suggests that goods come from a famous region must turn down the brand name. The Registrar of Geographical Indications, who is the Controller-General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, heads the registry of such regional names.

IN-STAT-0120.text: Yes, a waqf's manager may pay the cost of preparing its accounts out of its income, as provided in 'every mutawalli may pay from the income of the 1[waqf] property any expenses properly incurred by him for the purpose of enabling him to furnish... accounts under section 46' (Provision 1). The accounts must be filed before the '1st day of July' in every year (Provision 2).

IN-STAT-0121.text: A border force member who abets an offence punishable with death, which is not committed, is liable to suffer imprisonment for a term which may extend to fourteen years, as per 'no express provision is made by this Act for the punishment of such abetment' (Provision 1). If the offence involves the enemy and carries death, the member is liable to suffer death, as per 'offences in relation to the enemy and punishable with death' (Provision 3).

IN-STAT-0122.text: If one of a Christian couple is a minor and they live in Calcutta, Madras or Bombay, they may apply by petition to a Judge of the High Court for an order to issue the certificate before fourteen days, as provided in section 43. The Marriage Registrar shall issue the certificate in accordance with the order of the High Court.

IN-STAT-0123.text: Yes, the Government must set up an advisory body when it frames a scheme regulating dock work. The Advisory Committee shall include an equal number of members representing the Government, the dock workers, and the employers of dock workers, and shipping companies.

IN-STAT-0124.text: The Central Government shall give, in cash, to the Treasurer an amount equivalent to the sum of rupees one lakh for the transfer to, and vesting in, the Central Government, under section 3, of the Lady Hardinge Medical College and Hospital. The amount shall be paid within three months from the appointed day.

IN-STAT-0125.text: Under 'Public Gambling Act, 1867 — s. 16', a portion of the fine may be paid to an informer. Under 'Goa, Daman and Diu Public Gambling Act, 1976 — s. 3', anyone who opens, keeps, or uses a common gaming-house, or assists in its operation, is punishable with imprisonment and fine.

IN-STAT-0126.text: Persons eligible for free legal aid include those with annual income not exceeding Rs. 1 Lakh, members of SC/ST, women, children, disabled persons, victims of disasters, and persons in custody, as per 'the persons eligible for getting free legal services include: (a) Women and children’s; (b) Member of SC/ST; (c) Industrial workmen; (d) Victims of mass disaster... (h) Persons whose annual income does not exceed Rs. 1 Lakh' (Provision [3]). A sworn statement of income may be sufficient, as per 'An affidavit made by a person as to his income may be regarded as sufficient for making him eligible to the entitlement of legal services' (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0128.text: A Board shall meet at least once in every three months and shall observe such rules of procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be prescribed. 'the intervals and the time and place at which meetings of the Central Board or of any committee thereof shall be held and the procedure to be followed at such meetings, including the quorum necessary for the transaction of business' is determined by rules made under section 63 and 64.

IN-STAT-0130.text: If development works on one plot also benefit neighbouring land in Delhi, the owners of such other land shall be liable to contribute towards the expenses of carrying out the work such amount as the Board may determine. This contribution shall be recovered from those persons as arrears of land revenue.

IN-STAT-0131.text: Yes, it is a crime to knowingly give shelter to someone who is about to spy. The offence is punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 'three years', or with fine, or with both, as per 'Official Secrets Act, 1923 — s. 10' and 'Official Secrets Act, 1923 — s. 9'.

IN-STAT-0132.text: The Collector of the district in which any notified area is situate shall depute one or more Revenue Officers to accompany the forces engaged in the practice, who shall consider all claims for compensation under section 5 and determine the amount of compensation, if any, which shall be awarded in each case. "Compensation shall be payable for any damage to person or property or interference with rights or privileges arising from such practice".

IN-STAT-0133.text: The regulator that fixes airport charges consists of 'a Chairperson and two other Members' as per section 4 of the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India Act, 2008. The committee that recommends them is chaired by 'Cabinet Secretary' under section 5 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0134.text: The members of the Jamnagar body for traditional-medicine education serve for the term specified in the provision, and the Gujarat's health secretary sits on it as ex officio member.

IN-STAT-0135.text: Copies of rules, under 'Section 59' so far as they affect the government of prisons, shall be exhibited, both in English and in the Vernacular, in some place to which all persons employed within a prison have access.

IN-STAT-0138.text: A court can take up a charge of lying in import documents without official permission under 'Customs Act,1962 — Ch. XVI, s. 132' which punishes false declaration with imprisonment up to 3 years or fine. The maximum punishment is 'imprisonment for a term which may extend to 3 years' under section 132.

IN-STAT-0145.text: The notice must be made available in the local language to the Gram Panchayat, Nagar Nigam/Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, in the offices of the District Collector, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Office of concerned Land Acquisition Officer, Administrator, Tehsildar, published in two daily newspapers circulating in the affected area (at least one in the regional language), by public notice at conspicuous places in the affected areas, and uploaded on the website of the district or the Government. The Social Impact Assessment study shall be conducted by an independent outsourced district Social Impact Assessment agency, appointed by the State Government or Collector.

IN-STAT-0146.text: A notification appointing an official to collect statistics must state the name, designation and address of the officer, details of any agency engaged, terms and conditions of engagement, form and particulars required for statistical information, and powers delegated. The appropriate Government keeps the register of such officials.

IN-STAT-0147.text: The Delhi bed-and-breakfast host must furnish the particulars of any foreigner staying in his establishment to the Foreigners’ Registration Officer of the District within twenty-four hours of his checking-in in the Form prescribed under the Registration of Foreigners Rules, 1939. This is mandated under section 5(a) of the Delhi Act 11 of 2007.

IN-STAT-0149.text: When buying farmland in Goa, the buyer must undertake to take up agriculture on the land within three years from the date of acquisition and continue to carry thereon agriculture, as per section 3(1) of the Goa Restrictions on Transfer of Agricultural Land Act, 2023. Proof of being a farmer is accepted in the form of a Krishi Card or a Certificate issued by the Mamlatdar, or by an authorized competent authority of any State Government, as per section 3(1) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0151.text: Staff of Maharashtra's board for vocational training are treated as public servants under 'All members, officers and employees of the Board shall, when acting... be deemed to be public servants' (s. 56, [1]). The pay of staff carried over from the old board is governed by the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules or such other rules as may be made by the Government, as per 'during the period of such employment all matters relating to the pay... shall be regulated by the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules' (s. 21(1)(a), [2]).

IN-STAT-0152.text: The fund of Goa's statutory body for building schools and colleges consists of all monies received by the Corporation by way of grants, subventions, loans, advances or otherwise, fees, costs and charges, disposal of lands, buildings and other properties, rents and profits, and proceeds of any loan authorised by section 20. The Corporation may borrow in the open market as provided in section 20 of the Goa Education Development Corporation Act, 2003.

IN-STAT-0153.text: A Tamil Nadu trader using the 2011 scheme gets cleared upon the designated authority issuing a certificate under section 8(1) of the Tamil Nadu Sales Tax (Settlement of Arrears) Act, 2011. If the trader paid less than ninety per cent upfront, the application is summarily rejected under section 6(3) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0155.text: The person may appeal to the Collector of the district within thirty days from the date of communication of the order, as per 'Any person aggrieved by order of the Canal-Officer under sections 12, 19, 24, 34, 35, 37 and 38 may within thirty days from the date of communication of the order prefer an appeal to the Collector of the district' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0156.text: A person may appeal to the Karnataka Appellate Tribunal within ninety days from the date of the Deputy Commissioner's decision under sections 8, 16 and 24 of the KARNATAKA (SANDUR AREA) INAMS ABOLITION ACT, 1976. New occupants owe the state any excess payments as arrears of land revenue under section 30 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0157.text: The fine for not cancelling an adhesive stamp in Jammu and Kashmir is a penalty which may extend to 'ten thousand rupees' as per section 63 of the STAMP ACT, 1977. Cancellation requires that the stamp be cancelled so that it cannot be used again, as per section 12 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0158.text: The ceiling on how much farmland a cultivating lessee may acquire in the eastern Maharashtra region is determined by the Maharashtra Agricultural Lands (Ceiling on Holdings) Act, 1961. For lands falling under sub-clause (d) of clause (5) of section 2, the ceiling area is '21 85.29 (54 Acres)' in certain districts.

IN-STAT-0159.text: Since October 2023, Karnataka's GST penalty provision on e-commerce operators covers 'every person supplying online information and database access or retrieval services from a place outside India to a person in India, other than a registered person' as per section 24(ix) and (xi) of the KGST Act, 2017.

IN-STAT-0160.text: The Industrial Court settles fights over which union gets official recognition in Maharashtra. Someone found guilty by a labour judge has to challenge the decision within 'thirty days from the date of the conviction' under section 42(2).

IN-STAT-0161.text: No, goods seized for unpaid GST cannot be auctioned on a Sunday as per "No sale under the rules under the provision of this chapter shall take place on a Sunday or other general holidays recognized by the Government".

IN-STAT-0162.text: Under Uttar Pradesh's GST rules, costs a supplier pays on a client's behalf are left out of the taxable value when the value is determined as 'one per cent. of the gross amount of currency exchanged for an amount up to one lakh rupees, subject to a minimum amount of two hundred and fifty rupees' as per provision [1].

IN-STAT-0163.text: The Bikaner Development Commissioner, who shall be the Chairman, heads the Bikaner Traffic Control Board.

IN-STAT-0165.text: Within six months from the grant of letters of administration, the executor or administrator must exhibit in the Court an inventory containing a full and true estimate of all the property in possession, and all the credits, and also all the debts owing by any person to which the executor or administrator is entitled in that character.

IN-STAT-0166.text: Animals held at a quarantine station set up on a notified route may be vaccinated against any scheduled disease if in the opinion of the officer in charge of such station it is necessary to do so, and may be marked in the prescribed manner. "All animals inspected or detained at a quarantine station shall be liable— (a) to be vaccinated against any scheduled disease if in the opinion of the officer in charge of such station it is necessary to do so; and (b) to be marked in the prescribed manner." citations: [1], [2], [5], [6]

IN-STAT-0167.text: Under Goa, Daman and Diu Diseases of Animals Act, 1974, Pt. II, s. 30, a veterinary inspector who vexatiously and unnecessarily enters premises or seizes livestock may be fined up to 'five hundred rupees' as per the provision.

IN-STAT-0168.text: No, an advocate cannot speak for someone in a dispute heard by the taluka revenue officer, as per "no pleader shall be entitled to appear on behalf of any party in any proceedings under this Act before the Mamlatdar" (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0169.text: The municipal council must take proper precaution for guarding against accident by shoring up and protecting the adjoining building, and cause such bars, chains or posts as it shall think fit, to be fixed across or in any street to prevent the passage of carriages, carts or other vehicle, or of cattle or horses during the construction or repair work, and cause such work to be sufficiently lighted and guarded during the night.

IN-STAT-0170.text: Rules under the law on dissecting unclaimed bodies in Goa may fix the period within which a near relative shall claim the body of a deceased person, as provided in 'such rules may prescribe the period within which a near relative shall claim the body of a deceased person' (s. 10(2)).

IN-STAT-0171.text: The Central Provinces and Berar Local Government Act, 1948 (XXX of 1948) or the Central Provinces and Berar Panchayats Act, 1946 (I of 1947) became the default in the first list.

IN-STAT-0172.text: Yes, it is a crime under the Bihar Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017. 'issues any invoice or bill without supply of goods or services or both in violation of the provisions of this Act' is an offence under section 132(1)(b), citations: [1].

IN-STAT-0173.text: The premises of every establishment shall be kept clean and free from effluvia arising from any drain or privy or other nuisance.

IN-STAT-0175.text: The Registrar, Labour Court, the Industrial Court, a Board and a Court of Enquiry shall have the same powers as are vested in Civil Courts under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in respect of summoning and enforcing the attendance of any person and examining him on oath.

IN-STAT-0176.text: The reward payable by law when a police officer makes an arrest is paid to such officer, as per 'rewards payable by law for arrests shall, when the arrest is made by a Police officer, be paid to such officer' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0177.text: Every village headman, village accountant, village watchmen or other village official by whatever name called, shall forthwith inform the nearest police station or the nearest Highway Authority, whenever he becomes aware that any boundary mark of any highway has been damaged.

IN-STAT-0178.text: A police officer in Jammu and Kashmir may defend a prosecution by pleading that the act was done under a warrant issued by a Magistrate, as per 'such plea shall be proved by the production of a warrant directing the act, and purporting to be signed by such Magistrate' (Provisions 1, 4, 6).

IN-STAT-0179.text: The Government may restrict the movements of a registered habitual offender for a period not exceeding three years, as specified in the order, provided that the period specified in an order under sub-section (1) shall in no case extend beyond the period of registration or re-registration as the case may be, referred to in section 9.

IN-STAT-0181.text: Whoever fails without reasonable cause to comply with any of the requirements specified in a notification issued under sub-section (1) of section 13 or of a direction issued under sub-section (2) of that section shall be punishable with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.

IN-STAT-0186.text: Staff hired by the trustees of Kolkata's marble monument to the late Queen are treated as public servants, as per 'All officers and servants employed by the Trustees shall be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of the Indian Penal Code' (Provisions [1] and [2]). This coverage does not extend to 'persons in the service of any contractor employed by the Trustees' (Provisions [1], [2], and [3]).

IN-STAT-0188.text: The officer running a police station must record 'all complaints and charges preferred, the names of all persons arrested, the names of the complainants, the offences charged against them, the weapons or property that shall have been taken from their possession or otherwise, and the names of the witnesses who shall have been examined' as per section 44 of the Police Act, 1861.

IN-STAT-0189.text: The court may declare the debtor bankrupt again if default is made in the payment of any installment due in pursuance of any composition or scheme, approved as aforesaid, or if it appears to the Court that the composition or scheme cannot proceed without injustice or undue delay or that the approval of the Court was obtained by fraud.

IN-STAT-0191.text: The District Judge, under 'Until probate is granted of the will of a deceased person, or an administrator of his estate is constituted, the District Judge... to take and keep possession of the property' (s. 269(1)), is authorised and required to interfere for the protection of the property at the instance of any person claiming to be interested therein. The Judge shall determine summarily the right to possession and deliver possession accordingly, subject to a suit, as per s. 194.

IN-STAT-0193.text: A High Court judge may choose between leave on full allowances, leave on half allowances, or leave partly on full allowances and partly on half allowances. This is provided under 'Kinds of leave admissible to a judge' in sections 3 of the High Court Judges Salaries and Conditions of Service Act, 1954 (Provision 1) and the Supreme Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Act, 1958 (Provision 3).

IN-STAT-0195.text: The Centre can wind up the Marine Products Export Development Authority only by an order of the Central Government, as per 'No provision of any law relating to the winding up of companies or corporations shall apply to the Authority and it shall not be placed in liquidation save by an order of the Central Government' (Provision [34]).

IN-STAT-0196.text: Yes, the ordinary time limits for legal proceedings apply to appeals before the tribunal hearing stock-exchange disputes, as per "The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963) shall, as far as may be, apply to proceedings or appeals before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, as the case may be."

IN-STAT-0197.text: A state-backed development finance lender may disclose details about its customers' affairs only if required by law, as per 'A public financial institution shall not, except as otherwise provided in sub-section (2) or in any other law for the time being in force, divulge any information...' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0199.text: If a process-server of the presidency-town court for petty claims squeezes money out of people, the Court may inquire into such charge and make orders for repayment of the money extorted, and for damages and costs, as it thinks fit. 'If any clerk, bailiff or other inferior ministerial officer of the Small Cause Court is charged with extortion or misconduct...' (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0202.text: On the commencement of the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976, every obligation of a bonded labourer to repay any bonded debt, or such part of any bonded debt as remains unsatisfied immediately before such commencement, shall be deemed to have been extinguished.

IN-STAT-0204.text: The Unique Identification Authority of India must take special steps to enrol certain category of persons as provided in section 5 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.

IN-STAT-0205.text: If a territory's seat fell vacant before the old House was dissolved, it shall be filled by a person nominated by the President.

IN-STAT-0207.text: The bench of the body that hears service complaints of soldiers, sailors and airmen is constituted by a 'Court-martial' as defined in 's. 475(1)' and 's. 521(1)' of the respective provisions.

IN-STAT-0208.text: Section 4 of the Territorial Army Act, 1948 provides for the following classes of persons: 'officers; and enrolled persons.' (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0209.text: The Commissioner appoints municipal officers and other municipal employees, as provided in section 71B(1) of the Punjab Municipal Corporation Law (Extension to Chandigarh) Act, 1994.

IN-STAT-0210.text: The Central Government decides the Corporation's provision for depreciation and reserve funds under section 21 of the Faridabad Development Corporation Act, 1956. "The Corporation shall make such provision for depreciation and for reserve and other funds as the Central Government may from time to time direct."

IN-STAT-0211.text: None but persons named in lists to be deemed Taluqdárs or Grantees.

IN-STAT-0213.text: No, section 2 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 does not displace the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930. "The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to, and not in derogation of, the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930 (2 of 1930), and any other law for the time being in force."

IN-STAT-0214.text: The Technical Advisory Committee advises the Central Government for the purpose of addition of occupations and processes to the Schedule. The Committee shall consist of a Chairman and such other members not exceeding ten, as may be appointed by the Central Government.

IN-STAT-0215.text: Under section 15(1), the Governing Body has the power to review the acts of the Academic Council. "Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Governing Body of the University shall be responsible for the general policy making, superintendence, direction and control of the affairs of the University and shall exercise all the powers of the University not otherwise provided for by this Act, the Statutes and the Ordinances, and shall have the power to review the acts of the Academic Council."

IN-STAT-0216.text: The heirs of Sir Dinshaw Manockjee Petit to take his name.—The said Framjee Dinshaw Petit and the heirs male of his body and all other the heirs male of the body of the said Sir Dinshaw Manockjee Petit to whom the said title and dignity shall descend, pursuant to the limitations of the Patent whereby the said dignity was granted, shall take upon themselves respectively the names of "Dinshaw Manockjee Petit" in lieu and in the place of any other name or names whatever;

IN-STAT-0219.text: The enactments in the third schedule are in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the government of the Governor of Bombay in Council, except the Scheduled Districts subject to such government.

IN-STAT-0220.text: All persons whose names are entered in the register of the Actuarial Society at the commencement of this Act and all persons who may thereafter have their names entered in the register to be maintained under this Act, so long as they continue to have their names borne on the register, are hereby constituted a body corporate by the name of the Institute of Actuaries of India and all such persons shall be known as members of the Institute.

IN-STAT-0222.text: Under section 39 of the Architects Act, 1972, no court shall take cognizance of any offence punishable under this Act, except upon complaint made by order of the Council or a person authorised in this behalf by the Council.

IN-STAT-0223.text: Under section 28 of the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005, the State Commission is funded by grants paid by the State Government, as per 'The State Government shall, after due appropriation made by Legislature by law in this behalf, pay to the State Commission by way of grants such sums of money as the State Government may think fit for being utilised for the purposes of this Act.'

IN-STAT-0224.text: The court shall take into account any loss suffered or likely to be suffered by authorised users.

IN-STAT-0225.text: It shall come into force on the 1st day of September, 1943.

IN-STAT-0226.text: The national body regulating engineering and management colleges must convene at least three times in a calendar year, as per 'The Governing Body shall meet at least three times in a calendar year.' In the absence of the head, the meeting shall be chaired by 'any one of the nominees of the Chancellor' as per 'All meetings of the Board of Governors shall always be chaired by the Chancellor and in his absence by any one of the nominees of the Chancellor.'

IN-STAT-0228.text: A person shall not be qualified to be chosen to fill a seat in the Legislative Assembly of a State unless, in the case of a seat reserved for the Scheduled Castes, he is a member of any of those castes and is an elector for any Assembly constituency in that State.

IN-STAT-0230.text: Payment by attorney under power, without notice of death, etc., good.

IN-STAT-0234.text: Yes, the degrees awarded by the national institute for footwear design are recognised as equal to university degrees. 'The Institute shall have the power to grant degrees... which shall be equivalent to such corresponding degrees... granted by any University or Institute established or incorporated under any other law for the time being in force.' (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0235.text: An order of the tribunal deciding complaints about railway freight rates is enforced by the Tribunal's power to fix such rate or charge as it considers reasonable and direct a refund of the excess, as provided in 'the Tribunal may— (i) fix such rate or charge as it considers reasonable from any date as it may deem proper, not being a date earlier to the date of the filing of the complaint; (ii) direct a refund of amount, if any, as being the excess of the rate or charge fixed by the Tribunal under clause (i)' (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0236.text: Yes, a court may order the forfeiture of animals, vehicles, or other conveyances used in carrying stolen railway goods, as per "the animals, vehicles, or other conveyances used in carrying the property" under section 13 of the Railway Property (Unlawful Possession) Act, 1966.

IN-STAT-0237.text: As from the appointed day and until the first meeting of the Legislative Assembly of a new State other than Kerala, the persons who immediately before the appointed day are the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of the corresponding State shall, if they are members of the Legislative Assembly of the new State, be the Speaker and Deputy Speaker, respectively, of that Assembly.

IN-STAT-0238.text: Besides the organisation, every person who was in charge of, and was responsible to, the society or trust for the conduct of its business, as well as the promoter of the society or settlor of the trust, is treated as guilty. This is stated in 'every person (including the promoter of society or settlor of the trust) who at the time the offence was committed was in charge of, and was responsible to, the society or trust for the conduct of the business of the society or the trust, as well as the society or trust, shall be deemed to be guilty of the offence' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0239.text: Each State and Union territory having Legislature shall constitute a Board to be known as the State Assisted Reproductive Technology and Surrogacy Board or the Union territory Assisted Reproductive Technology and Surrogacy Board, as the case may be.

IN-STAT-0240.text: Whoever contravenes any provision of this Act, shall be liable to pay the penalty which may extend to ten thousand rupees.

IN-STAT-0242.text: The punishment for sabotaging air navigation equipment in a way that endangers aircraft in flight is imprisonment for life and fine, as per 'Whoever unlawfully and intentionally destroys or damages air navigation facilities or interferes with their operation in such a manner as is likely to endanger the safety of the aircraft in flight shall be punished with imprisonment for life and shall also be liable to fine' under [1].

IN-STAT-0243.text: No, a tenant cannot grant someone a right of way over the rented land that lasts after the tenancy ends, as per 'the tenancy in respect of the land comprising such way shall be deemed to have been extinguished' under section 246 of the Rajasthan Tenancy Act, 1955.

IN-STAT-0245.text: A securities depository acts through participants, as stated in 'the participant after satisfaction that the securities are available for pledge shall make a note in its records of the notice of pledge and forward the application to the depository' (Provision 1). The relationship is set up through agreements between the participant and the depository, as mentioned in 'Any participant may enter into an agreement with the depository to act as its agent' (Provision 4).

IN-STAT-0246.text: Supply of goods or services or both, when the supplier is located in India and the place of supply is outside India, shall be treated to be a supply of goods or services or both in the course of inter-State trade or commerce.

IN-STAT-0248.text: The consent must be 'free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action' as per section 6(1) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

IN-STAT-0249.text: Under section 52(1)(b) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, the Court shall take judicial notice of 'international treaty, agreement or convention with country or countries by India, or decisions made by India at international associations or other bodies'. Section 51 states that 'No fact of which the Court will take judicial notice need be proved'.

IN-STAT-0253.text: The National Authority, as established under 'section 6 of the Chemical Weapons Convention Act, 2000', fulfils the obligations of the Government of India under the Convention and acts as the national focal point for liaison with the Organization and other States Parties.

IN-STAT-0254.text: Under the Kerala Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1976, s. 18, the Regional Transport Officer may accept a sum of money not exceeding two hundred and fifty rupees 'by way of composition of such offence' from a person who has committed, or is reasonably suspected of having committed, an offence under this Act. The sum is fixed by the Regional Transport Officer.

IN-STAT-0256.text: A Supreme Court judge may combine vacation on full salary with leave, provided that the leave is taken either at the commencement or at the end of the vacation but not both, as per 'where the vacation consists of one continuous period, the leave is taken either at the commencement or at the end of the vacation but not at both' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0257.text: No, the Centre cannot apply a state's laws to the former Portuguese enclave administered from Silvassa. 'For the avoidance of doubt it is hereby declared...' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0260.text: The law in force immediately before the appointed day with respect to the custody of the Seal of the High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Meghalaya, Manipur, Tripura and Mizoram shall, with the necessary modifications, apply with respect to the custody of the Seal of the common High Court.

IN-STAT-0263.text: Section 6 of the Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937 repeals 'The under mentioned provisions' of the Acts and Regulations mentioned below shall be repealed in so far as they are inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, namely:—

IN-STAT-0264.text: a warrant in accordance with such order shall be forwarded by the officer making the order or his staff officer or such person as may be prescribed, to the officer in charge of the prison in which such person is confined.

IN-STAT-0265.text: The Act extends to the territories which were on the 11th March, 1887, respectively administered by the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal, the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces and the Chief Commissioner of Assam, except such portions of those territories as for the time being are not subject to the ordinary civil jurisdiction of the High Courts.

IN-STAT-0266.text: Each Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages shall cause indexes of all the certified copies of registers sent to his office under this Act, or under Act 3 of 18721 the Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872 (15 of 1872), or the Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 18652 (15 of 1865), as amended by this Act, to be made and kept in his office in the prescribed form.

IN-STAT-0268.text: Under section 13 of the Indian Naval Armament Act, 1923, no Court inferior to that of a Presidency Magistrate or Magistrate of the first class shall proceed to the trial of any offence punishable under this Act, and no Court shall proceed to the trial of any such offence except on complaint made by, or under authority from, the Central Government.

IN-STAT-0270.text: Any person arrested under the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 shall be made over to the officer in charge of the nearest police station with the least possible delay, together with a report of the circumstances occasioning the arrest.

IN-STAT-0271.text: The rulings of the national body developing river and canal shipping routes are made official by 'by notification in the Official Gazette' under the Inland Waterways Authority of India Act, 1985, s. 35(1).

IN-STAT-0272.text: Yes, the tribunal hearing appeals in telephone and internet disputes must follow the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, as the tribunal shall have the same powers as are vested in a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Central Act No. V of 1908) in respect of hearing and deciding of an appeal or any dispute referred to it.

IN-STAT-0273.text: No, the Union government cannot fund itself with loans from the Mumbai-based monetary authority. 'The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 — Ch. II, s. 17 Business which the Bank may transact' specifies that the Reserve Bank of India may not lend or borrow funds for the Union government's funding.

IN-STAT-0274.text: Yes, officials can commandeer a private truck during a calamity under 'the maintenance of public order or of the services and supplies essential to the life of the community' as per section 3 of Maharashtra (Requisitioning and Control) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1965.

IN-STAT-0275.text: It shall be presumed that such records or property belong or belongs to such person.

IN-STAT-0280.text: If a plant breeder deliberately hides that a new crop variety was developed from seeds kept by village or tribal communities, the Authority may issue a notice to the breeder and grant compensation to the community, as per 'the variety with which the report is related has been registered under the provisions of this Act' (Section 41(3)), and the compensation shall be deposited in the Gene Fund (Section 41(4)).

IN-STAT-0281.text: Yes, a wife may sue on her own to recover property that is legally hers alone, as 'A married woman may maintain a suit in her own name for the recovery of property of any description which, by force of the said Indian Succession Act, 1865 or of this Act, is her separate property' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0282.text: An owner may get back an animal seized under West Bengal Municipal Act, 1993 s. 345(1) by paying all the expenses incurred by the Municipality and producing sufficient evidence of ownership within seven days of such seizure.

IN-STAT-0283.text: Yes, an unregistered ship brought to India to be broken up can be put on the Indian register under 'temporary registration of vessels sought to be recycled' as provided in s. 17 of the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025.

IN-STAT-0285.text: The proprietor of such carriage shall be liable to every such penalty as if he had been the driver of such carriage or owner of such horse at the time when such offence was committed.

IN-STAT-0286.text: Under 's. 8 Redressal of grievances of Aadhaar number holders' of The Aadhaar (Sharing of Information) Regulations, 2016, the Aadhaar number holder may raise queries and grievances in accordance with regulation 32 of the Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) Regulations, 2016.

IN-STAT-0287.text: The firm holding pension scheme assets is given 'ten working days’ notice' before a regulator's audit, unless the Authority is satisfied that such inspection or audit is required for immediate safeguarding of the interest of the subscribers.

IN-STAT-0289.text: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (Procedure for Authority Meetings) Regulations, 2015 require the Authority to meet 'not less than four times in a year' (citations: [1]).

IN-STAT-0290.text: Both the holder of the electronic negotiable warehouse receipt and the pledgee must instruct the repository.

IN-STAT-0291.text: Waste containing banned long-lasting toxic chemicals must be disposed of as per the provisions of the Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016.

IN-STAT-0292.text: The undelivered money order shall be returned to the remitter and the amount of the money order shall be paid to the remitter excluding the commission thereof.

IN-STAT-0294.text: A male candidate who has more than one wife living shall not be eligible for appointment to a post in the service "provided that the Board may, if satisfied that there exist special grounds for doing, so exempt any person from the operation of this regulation." (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0295.text: If part of the Hyderabad museum board's central grant is unspent at year end, it is not lost. The 'Standing Committee may sanction the expenditure of such budget grant or such unexpended portion thereof, as the case may be, during the next two following years' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0298.text: Under section 7 of the Rehabilitation Finance Administration Act, 1948, a member must "immediately disclose it to the Administration and shall either resign his membership or disclose of his interest in such manner and within such time as he may be directed by it."

IN-STAT-0300.text: The State to which the territories are transferred bears the guarantee for a co-operative society operating only in the transferred territories.

IN-STAT-0302.text: Section 7 of the Chandigarh Disturbed Areas Act, 1983 repeals "The Chandigarh Disturbed Areas Ordinance, 1983 (6 of 1983)".

IN-STAT-0305.text: The Principal Commissioner of Customs or Commissioner of Customs, as the case may be, issues the permit to run a special bonded warehouse for imported goods.

IN-STAT-0307.text: An officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary.

IN-STAT-0308.text: No, the bank cannot hand over subscriber data to others at will. "The point of presence shall not, without the prior permission of Authority, produce or share such data or information as evidence, or for any other purpose, except as required by the due process of law." (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0309.text: Grid-use fees for consumers buying power from other suppliers for short periods are fixed as operating charges, which include fee for scheduling, system operation and collection and disbursement of charges. These charges are payable by the applicant under 'The Himachal Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Short Term Open Access) Regulations, 2010 — Sch. None, s. 17 Operating Charges'.

IN-STAT-0310.text: If the Chairman of the Jharkhand Electricity Regulatory Commission cannot attend, any other member nominated by the Chairman shall preside at the meeting/proceeding.

IN-STAT-0311.text: When India's largest public-sector lender issues preference shares, it must follow the guidelines set out in "the issue of such shares has been authorized by passing a special resolution in the general meeting of the company" under [1].

IN-STAT-0313.text: Yes, the officer may demand a guarantor. "The proper officer may require that the bond to be executed under these regulations may be with such surety or security, or both, as he deems fit."

IN-STAT-0314.text: Every Member shall submit at each meeting of the Authority a Specific Declaration of Interest in Schedule I

IN-STAT-0315.text: The Tahsildar or the authorized officer shall on receipt of the order of the Court issue or arrange to issue a direction in Form –V deputing any officer not below the rank of a Revenue Inspector to take possession of the grabbed land on behalf of the Court and deliver possession of the land to the person ordered by the Court.

IN-STAT-0316.text: Any firm aggrieved by the industrial estate corporation's refusal of a plot transfer shall approach the Grievance Redressal Authority appointed by the Board of Directors of the Corporation. "Any applicant affected by the decision of the Corporation in the matter of allotment of plot or its refusal, shall approach the Grievance Redressal Authority appointed by the Board of Directors of the Corporation." citations: [1], [4]}

IN-STAT-0318.text: When the Reserves are called up, officers who are abroad shall receive notice thereof from the Registrar of Reserves or the nearest Indian representative. They shall then present themselves abroad the first Indian Naval Ship they meet and also report by letter to the Registrar of Reserves in India and to the nearest Indian representative.

IN-STAT-0319.text: The Central Government shall set up and maintain a secure electronic registry in which all the applications, financial statement, prospectus, return, register, memorandum, articles, particulars of charges, or any particulars or returns or any other documents filed under the Act to be electronically stored.

IN-STAT-0320.text: The 'Stock Disposal Register' in Form 5 records securities handed back from trust funds for public welfare.

IN-STAT-0322.text: The Collector's order on the use of village common land may be reviewed by the Commissioner of Land Administration under Rule 10 of the Tamil Nadu Panchayat (Restriction and Control to regulate the use of Porambokes in Ryotwari Tracts) Rules, 2000. A further challenge may go to the Government against the Commissioner's order.

IN-STAT-0323.text: The licence fee shall be paid in cash at the time of presenting the application or by remitting it by postal money order addressed to the Assistant Registrar or by crediting to Government account at a Treasury, or the Reserve Bank of India, and forwarding the receipt of the postal money order or the receipted chalan to the Assistant Registrar along with the application.

IN-STAT-0324.text: Electricity tax recovered in excess, if any, during the month may either be adjusted in future bills or refunded, subject to verification, by the licensee in case of sale. 'Electricity tax recovered in excess, if any, during the month may either be adjusted in future bills or refunded, subject to verification, by the licensee in case of sale' (Rule 9(2), Rule 17).

IN-STAT-0326.text: Yes, an app can let users verify themselves with Aadhaar to create a digital health ID, as per "Entities which are desirous of allowing voluntary Aadhaar authentication as one of the options for users to create health ID, share health information under various Health IT applications shall be permitted to do so" (Provision [3]).

IN-STAT-0328.text: After notifying the authorities of their establishment, a shop owner in Gujarat gets back a 'receipt of such intimation in Form-E' as quoted in [1].

IN-STAT-0329.text: The State Board enforces the rules on used car batteries, and it shall file an annual compliance status report to the Central Pollution Control Board by "30th April of every year".

IN-STAT-0330.text: Money collected as fines for polluting rivers ends up in the 'Environmental Protection Fund established under section 16 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986' as per 'section 45D of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974' and 'section 7 of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) (Manner of Holding Inquiry and Imposition of Penalty) Rules, 2024'.

IN-STAT-0332.text: The keeper of the animal enclosure shall remit the fines realised to the Government Treasury of the Taluk for being credited to the appropriate head of account in favour of the District Magistrate as required by sub-section (2) of Section 10.

IN-STAT-0334.text: If the occupant is not at home, the housing board may affix a copy of the notice on the outer door or some other conspicuous part of the ordinary residence or usual place of business of such person, and return the original notice to the Collector with a report stating that the copy has been so affixed.

IN-STAT-0336.text: These regulations shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 2009.

IN-STAT-0337.text: Food Business Operator shall comply with all the provisions of these regulations by 1st July, 2020.

IN-STAT-0338.text: These rules shall be deemed to have come into force on 1st day of April, 1988.

IN-STAT-0364.text: The duty of directors under the Companies Act 2013 is to 'act in good faith in order to promote the objects of the company for the benefit of its members as a whole, and in the best interests of the company, its employees, the shareholders, the community and for the protection of environment'.

IN-STAT-0367.text: The Constitution of Nepal allows citizenship by descent through the Citizenship Act, 1955, s. 4, which states: 'For the purposes of the proviso to sub-section (1), any person born outside undivided India who was, or was deemed to be, a citizen of India at the commencement of the Constitution shall be deemed to be a citizen of India by descent only.'

IN-STAT-0369.text: The notice period required is thirty days, or such longer period as may be required under the terms of employment.

IN-STAT-0373.text: Property may be expropriated under section 25 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa when an offence punishable under section 25 has been committed, and the Authorized Officer is satisfied that such property was used in committing the offence, as provided in "the Authorized Officer may whether or not a prosecution is instituted for the commission of such offence, order confiscation of the property so seized".

IN-STAT-0375.text: The Supreme Court of India held in Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation that 'the notification issued and the steps that are taken for improving the slum and for providing alternative accommodation is valid' (citations: [2]).

IN-STAT-0376.text: The Supreme Court of India in Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India decriminalized homosexuality by striking down Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code, which criminalized same-sex relationships. This decision was based on the Constitution of India's guarantee of fundamental rights, including equality and freedom of expression.

IN-STAT-0390.text: During the period from 15th February to 15th April every year, there shall be a ban on trekking.

IN-STAT-0391.text: No Government Servant shall take part in, subscribe in aid of, or assist in any political movement or activity.

IN-STAT-0392.text: In Rajasthan jails, an inmate's mail can be held back if it is found that the prisoner is corresponding with undesirable persons or receiving letters from them, or if any correspondence is found detrimental to the prisoner's rehabilitation, as per 'such letters, both incoming and outgoing, shall be withheld' (1).

IN-STAT-0393.text: The employer must give notice of lock-out in 'Form M' and display it conspicuously on a notice board at the main entrance to the establishment and in the Manager's office.

IN-STAT-0395.text: The Village Panchayat may fell and auction off live trees on the bunds of small tanks which serve as sources of supply of drinking water, if the leaves of such trees fall into the tanks and render unfit for drinking purposes. "live trees on the bunds of small tanks which serve as sources of supply of drinking water, if the leaves of such trees fall into the tanks and render unfit for drinking purposes." citations: [1]

IN-STAT-0396.text: The refund is made after deducting 10% of the deposited amount subject to a minimum of Rs. 200/- and a maximum of Rs. 5000/-

IN-STAT-0399.text: Yes, if a voter is already inside the polling station when time runs out, they shall be allowed to cast their votes, as per rule 41(1) of the Rajasthan Municipalities (Election) Rules, 1994: "all voters present at the polling station before it is closed shall be allowed to cast their votes."

IN-STAT-0400.text: The State Level Committee shall conduct meeting at least once in two months to review the work and functions of Law Officers.

IN-STAT-0401.text: A Minister in Maharashtra may claim one mileage at the rate of 55 paise per kilometer plus a lump payment of Rs. 150 for driving by private car to take up office, as provided in "Where a Minister performs the journey by road for assuming office in a motor vehicle (not being a vehicle plying for conveyance of passengers), he may draw one mileage at the rate of 55 paise per kilometer plus a lump payment of Rs. 150." citations: [1]

IN-STAT-0403.text: The biodiversity board can refuse someone collecting plants or animals for research or trade if it considers that the request cannot be acceded to, after recording the reasons, as stated in 'the Board may reject the application if it considers that the request cannot be acceded to, after recording the reasons' (provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0404.text: The Finance Commission makes recommendations to the President as to the distribution between the Union and the States of the net proceeds of taxes which are to be, or may be, divided between them under this Chapter.

IN-STAT-0406.text: The particulars of first directors of the company and their consent to act as such shall be filed in Form No.DIR.12

IN-STAT-0407.text: The Registrar shall issue a certificate in Form MSC-2 allowing the status of a dormant company to the applicant.

IN-STAT-0409.text: The packer certified to sell Agmark gur must get its product tested at the premises of the authorized packer, as per the provisions of the General Grading and Marking Rules, 1988.

IN-STAT-0411.text: If a protected heritage site has no specified visiting hours, the public may enter from sunrise to sunset, as per 'protected monuments which are not so specified and to which neither rule 3 nor rule 4 applies shall remain open from sunrise to sunset' (citations: [3], [4], [5], [6], [7]).

IN-STAT-0412.text: The station house officer needs 'written authorisation of an officer not below the rank of Superintendent of Police' before searching premises linked to an illegal deposit-taking scheme, as per 'Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 — Ch. VII, s. 31'.

IN-STAT-0414.text: If the value of imported goods cannot be determined under rules 3, 4 and 5, the value shall be determined under the provisions of rule 7 or, when the value cannot be determined under that rule, under rule 8. "Provided that at the request of the importer, and with the approval of the proper officer, the order of application of rules 7 and 8 shall be reversed." [1]

IN-STAT-0415.text: The Secretary shall have the same Administrative and Financial Powers as are delegated to a minor Head of the Department by the Government from time to time.

IN-STAT-0416.text: If on scrutiny the appeal is found to be in order, it shall be registered and given a serial number.

IN-STAT-0421.text: The amount will be drawn in cash by the Local Bodies under the counter signatures of the Executive Engineer, Public Works Department (B & R).

IN-STAT-0423.text: The Tamil Nadu Control of Industrial Major Accident Hazards Rules, 1994 supplement the rules already notified under Chapter IV-A of the Factories Act, 1948 (Central Act 63 of 1948).

IN-STAT-0424.text: The Chairperson shall be the appointing authority in respect of the Categories in Division I and Division II; "The Secretary shall be the appointing authority in respect of the categories in Division III, Provided that the selection shall be made by the Chairperson."

IN-STAT-0425.text: The Examiner shall send his Audit Report to the Chairman or other Executive Head of the Local Authority concerned and a copy thereof to such authorities as the Government may direct.

IN-STAT-0426.text: No allotment of Government land shall be made to any displaced agriculturist or landless tenant even though his lands have been acquired in the project, if: (i) he holds 20 acres or more of commanded or irrigated tenure land in the project area at any other place, (ii) 75 acres of Barani land anywhere in Rajasthan.

IN-STAT-0427.text: The fees or allowances, if any, to be paid to the persons associated with the inquiry under sub-rule (1), shall be determined by the Claims Commissioner as he considers necessary, and the same shall be paid by the Metro Railway Administration.

IN-STAT-0429.text: For the grant of a certificate, a fee of one rupee for each animal to be slaughtered shall be paid.

IN-STAT-0431.text: The books of account shall be maintained both in Kannada and English, in the Accounts Forms as provided in Schedule-III

IN-STAT-0432.text: No examination of a boiler shall be made by an inspector for the purpose of registering or issuing a certificate for a boiler on a Sunday or gazetted public holiday or between the hours of sunset and sunrise without the specific orders of the Chief Inspector in each case.

IN-STAT-0433.text: A member may inspect the following documents in the office of the Registrar on payment of a fee of rupee five for each occasion

IN-STAT-0434.text: Where the value of the export goods cannot be determined under the provisions of rules 4 and 5, the value shall be determined using reasonable means consistent with the principles and general provisions of these rules provided that local market price of the export goods may not be the only basis for determining the value of export goods.

IN-STAT-0436.text: Every public notice given under this Act or any rule or regulation made thereunder shall be in writing over the signature of the officer concerned and shall be widely made known in the locality to be affected thereby, affixing copies thereof in conspicuous public places, within the said locality, or by publishing the same by beat of drum or by advertisement in a newspaper having wide circulation in the locality, or by any two or more of these means, and by other means as the officer may think fit.

IN-STAT-0438.text: No, the lands vesting in the Board under section 20 of the Rajasthan Bhoodan Yagna Act, 1954 are not liable to attachment or sale in execution of any decree or order passed by a civil court against the Board.

IN-STAT-0440.text: Under section 17 of the Goa Ayurvedic and other Allied Indian Systems of Medicine Council Act, 2019, it shall be lawful for the President to summon a meeting of the Council at such time and place as he may deem expedient by circulating notice to each member.

IN-STAT-0441.text: The Indian Easements Act, 1882 (Central Act 5 of 1882), as in force in the Malabar district referred to in sub-section (2) of section 5 of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 (Central Act 37 of 1956), is hereby extended to, and shall be in force in, the whole of the State of Kerala.

IN-STAT-0442.text: The Magistrate trying the case may direct any portion of any fine which shall be levied under sections 3 and 4 of this Act, or any part of the moneys or proceeds of articles seized and ordered to be forfeited under this Act, to be paid to an informer.

IN-STAT-0443.text: A gaming witness is indemnified when 'upon such examination, shall in the opinion of the Magistrate make true and faithful discovery, to the best of his knowledge, of all things as to which he shall be so examined' under section 11 of the Public Gambling Act, 1867 as in force in Rajasthan.

IN-STAT-0446.text: The University's general fund is credited with 'its income from fees, endowments and grants, and any other income accruing to the University' and 'grants from the Central Government, the University Grants Commission, International Donor Agencies like the World Health Organization and the United Nations International Children’s Fund' as per section 35 of the Himachal Pradesh University of Health Sciences Act, 2017.
