IN-STAT-0447.text: The Chief Whip is paid at the same rates as are admissible to a Minister under the Ministers of the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1994 (Delhi Act No. 8 of 1995).

IN-STAT-0449.text: Cases the Tribunal received from civil courts go back to the same Civil Court from which they were transferred, or to the court of competent jurisdiction in its place, as if it was a plaint under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908).

IN-STAT-0450.text: Under section 13 of the Chhattisgarh Bhumi Sena Adhiniyam, 1981, a Bhumi Sainik on duty shall have the same powers, privileges and protection as a public servant under any enactment for the time being in force.

IN-STAT-0451.text: The Finance Officer is the Secretary of the Finance Committee.

IN-STAT-0452.text: A chemist struck off the register faces a penalty of 'a fine which may extend to fifty rupees' if he fails to surrender the certificate of registration forthwith, and the penalty shall be paid within ten days from the date on which the person’s name was removed from the register.

IN-STAT-0454.text: All records, charts, forms, reports, consent letters and all other documents shall be preserved for a period of two years or for such period as may be prescribed, "provided that, if any criminal or other proceedings are instituted against any Genetic Counselling Centre, Genetic Laboratory or Genetic Clinic, the records and all other documents of such Centre, Laboratory or Clinic shall be preserved till the final disposal of such proceedings." (Provisions [1], [5], [7])

IN-STAT-0456.text: Before a state converts forest land to non-forest use, the prior approval of the Central Government is needed, and the Project Screening Committee advises on granting it. 'Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law... no State Government... shall make... except with the prior approval of the Central Government' (Provision [1] s. 2).

IN-STAT-0458.text: If canal water is wasted and the culprit cannot be found, all the persons chargeable in respect of the water supplied through such canal shall be jointly liable for the charges made in respect of the water so wasted. "all the persons chargeable in respect of the water supplied through such canal shall be jointly liable for the charges made in respect of the water so wasted." citations: [1], [3], [6], [7]

IN-STAT-0459.text: The Centre could handle references in state laws to old authorities by treating them as references to the new authorities, as per section 4: 'Any reference... to any authority competent... shall, where a corresponding new authority has been constituted... have effect as if it were a reference to the new authority.'

IN-STAT-0463.text: A member of the army's reserve pool who, with no valid excuse, doesn't turn up when summoned may be 'struck off the effective strength of the reserve' and may be 'tried by court-martial or by the civil authorities for an offence under the Indian Reserve Forces Act, 1888, Section 6'.

IN-STAT-0465.text: Yes, the constable is committing an offence under 'knowing or having reason to believe in the existence of any mutiny... does not, without delay, give information thereof to his superior officer' (s. 9, Central Reserve Police Force Act, 1949).

IN-STAT-0467.text: Offences involving property held in someone else's name are tried by 'Special Courts' designated by the Central Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court. These courts are established under Section 50 of the Prohibition of Benami Property Transactions Act, 1988.

IN-STAT-0468.text: No person shall be entitled to recover possession of any timber collected or delivered as aforesaid until he has paid to the Forest-officer or other person entitled to receive such sum on account thereof as may be due under any rule made under section 51.

IN-STAT-0469.text: The maximum punishment for maliciously setting off a blast likely to endanger life, even if nobody is hurt, is 'imprisonment for life, or with rigorous imprisonment of either description which shall not be less than ten years, and shall also be liable to fine' as per section 3(a) of the Explosive Substances Act, 1908.

IN-STAT-0470.text: The medical qualifications in Indian System of Medicine at undergraduate or postgraduate or super-speciality level granted by any University or medical institution in India shall be listed and maintained by the Board of Ayurveda or the Board of Unani, Siddha and Sowa-Rigpa, as the case may be, in such manner as may be specified by regulations.

IN-STAT-0471.text: The council may drain a block of buildings together if it appears to the Chairperson that any group or block of premises may be drained more economically or advantageously in combination than separately, and a municipal drain of sufficient size already exists or is about to be constructed within thirty meters of any part of that group or block of premises.

IN-STAT-0472.text: No, the manufacturer cannot demand a share. 'Where an Inspector takes a sample of a drug 2[or cosmetic] for the purpose of test or analysis, he shall intimate such purpose in writing in the prescribed form to the person from whom he takes it and, in the presence of such person unless he wilfully absents himself, shall divide the sample into four portions and effectively seal and suitably mark the same and permit such person to add his own seal and mark to all or any of the portions so sealed and marked' [1].

IN-STAT-0474.text: In case of non-payment of any such toll on demand, the officers appointed to collect the same may seize any part of the burden or load of the carriage or animal on which the toll is chargeable, of sufficient value to defray the toll.

IN-STAT-0475.text: The Executive Council may reject the proposal or return the draft to the Academic Council for reconsideration, either in whole or in part, together with any amendment which the Executive Council may suggest.

IN-STAT-0476.text: The Dean of Students’ Welfare chairs the Students’ Council, as per 'the Dean of Students’ Welfare who shall be the Chairman of the Students’ Council' (Provision 1). Members are picked by the Academic Council nominating twenty students on the basis of merit in studies, sports and extra-curricular activities, and twenty elected by the students (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0477.text: A service-contract quarrel between a government-funded IT institute and its employee is settled by referring the dispute to a Tribunal of Arbitration consisting of one member appointed by the Institute, one member nominated by the employee, and an umpire appointed by the Visitor. "No suit or proceeding shall lie in any court in respect of any matter, which is required by sub-section (1) to be referred to the Tribunal of Arbitration." citations: [1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6], [7], [8]

IN-STAT-0478.text: No, India's state-owned life insurer cannot buy goods from a company linked to one of its directors, as per 'None of the directors/partners or and employees of the company are holding any directorship/ employment in or represent any other insurance related entity.' (citation: 1)

IN-STAT-0479.text: No, a single permit cannot be obtained for running a plant, cigar rolling and hiring labour through middlemen. "the application is made bona fide on behalf of the applicant himself or in benami of any other person" (s. 4(3)(d), Beedi and Cigar Workers (Conditions and Employment) Act, 1966).

IN-STAT-0480.text: The Centre created the 'Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation' as a body corporate.

IN-STAT-0482.text: Persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes, landless labourers and such other class or classes of persons as the State Government may, having regard to their economic backwardness, by notification, specify.

IN-STAT-0489.text: Yes, penalties already incurred under the old law did not lapse. "any penalty, forfeiture or punishment incurred in respect of any offence committed under the Act so repealed".

IN-STAT-0490.text: Any arrears of surcharge recoverable under the repealed Travancore-Cochin Electricity Supply Surcharge Act, 1955 shall be credited in the revenue accounts of the Kerala State Electricity Board as if it were the revenue accruing to that Board.

IN-STAT-0491.text: An accused person starts negotiating a lighter sentence in exchange for admitting guilt by filing an application for plea bargaining under section 265B(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

IN-STAT-0492.text: A claim for an accident may be made before the Commissioner, as provided in 'a claim for such compensation may, subject to the provisions of this Act, be made before the Commissioner.'

IN-STAT-0493.text: The Superintendent shall return the warrant, to the Court which issued it with an endorsement to be countersigned by the Medical Officer and the Executive Magistrate.

IN-STAT-0496.text: Yes, in Jharkhand, a co-operative society may recover a member's debt from that member's shares and deposits. This is provided under 'the society shall have a charge upon the share or interest of such member in the capital of the society, upon the deposits of such member with the society and upon any dividend, rebate or profits payable to such member' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0497.text: The state commission for protecting cattle in Himachal Pradesh must meet 'as often as may be necessary' as per section 7 of the Himachal Pradesh Private Educational Institutions (Regulatory Commission) Act, 2010.

IN-STAT-0499.text: Yes, a non-official member of the Bengaluru Metropolitan Land Transport Authority may resign by notice in writing addressed to the Authority, and shall continue to hold office till the acceptance of the resignation by the Authority.

IN-STAT-0500.text: Yes, the Government may exempt any horse race from the operation of the Karnataka Race Courses Licensing Act, 1952 by a general or special order published in the Mysore Gazette, as per 'The Government may, by general or special order published in the Mysore Gazettte exempt any horse race from the operation of this act.' (s. 10).

IN-STAT-0502.text: No, the housing authority cannot spend money borrowed for giving loans on something else, as per 'Money borrowed for advancing loans not to be utilised for other purposes' (s. 163, [1]).

IN-STAT-0504.text: Offices in Goa must publicise which services they offer and how fast they must deliver them on the notice-board in every authority, notified in the Official Gazette and Citizens Charter, and also on the website of the concerned authority, as per section 8 of the Goa (Right of Citizens to Time-Bound Delivery of Public Services) Act, 2013. This is also reiterated in section 6 of the Goa (Right of Citizens to Time-Bound Delivery of Public Services) Rules, 2014.

IN-STAT-0506.text: The Vice-chancellor of the University concerned shall be Chairperson of the Committee.

IN-STAT-0507.text: If a person finds that another person has already voted in their name, they may challenge the identity of the elector under section 64 of the Punjab Municipal Election Rules, 1994, by depositing a sum of rupees five in cash with the Presiding Officer. "If after the enquiry, the Presiding Officer is satisfied that the challenge has not been established, he shall allow the person challenged to vote".

IN-STAT-0508.text: The Students' Welfare Officer is answerable to the Vice-Chancellor for student welfare.

IN-STAT-0509.text: No, the ban on cruelty to animals in Karnataka does not stop traditional buffalo races in paddy fields. The conduct of 'Kambala' is explicitly exempted under section 27 and section 11 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960, as amended by Karnataka Act 2 of 2018, with the decisive phrase: 'the conduct of 'Kambala' with a view to follow and promote tradition and culture and ensure survival and continuance of native breeds of buffaloes.'
